category_title: Preschoolers who experience slow transitions between activities
scenario_title: Transitioning between familiar activities in the preschool classroom
minimal_context: Jose is in the preschool classroom and needs to stop his current activity to move toward the next planned activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jose, it is time to stop your current activity and move to the next activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains calm and deeply engaged in his activity, not stopping to move toward the next activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop what you are doing and walk over here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues his activity without stopping, taking a long time to begin the transition.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jose, this is a verbal reminder that you need to move to the next activity now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets upset at the verbal reminder and does not stop his current activity, making the transition take even longer.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Jose, it is time to stop your current activity and move to the next activity.

STUDENT: (Remains calm and deeply engaged in his activity, not stopping to move toward the next activity.)

TUTOR: Please stop what you are doing and walk over here.

STUDENT: (Continues his activity without stopping, taking a long time to begin the transition.)

TUTOR: Jose, this is a verbal reminder that you need to move to the next activity now.

STUDENT: (Gets upset at the verbal reminder and does not stop his current activity, making the transition take even longer.)

task.content: Stop current activity and move (e.g., walks, crawls, hops) toward the next planned or familiar activity
task.learning_goal: Decrease the time between a visual prompt and the time it takes Jose to stop and move toward an activity (e.g., less than a 5-min average)

context.materials: Two picture cards with a movement action (e.g., walks, hops), visual supports, transition cues, choice board, first/then board
context.social_setting: Interacting with a teacher or a peer during classroom routines

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When given a verbal reminder to transition
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Gets upset and the transition seems to take longer
related_quotes: When we give him a verbal reminder, he gets upset and the transition seems to take longer.

behavior_patterns.condition: When prompted to transition to a planned activity
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Does not stop his current activity and move (e.g., walks, crawls, hops) toward the next activity, taking an average of 8 min 6 s to begin transitions
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Calm and deeply engages in activities
related_quotes: Jose is calm and deeply engages in activities but sometimes it takes Jose a long time to stop doing an activity and move toward the next activity.
